title: A linear layer learns weights
summary: nn.Linear combines input features into output values using learned weights and a bias. Two inputs can produce one output.
introduction: nn.Linear combines input features into output values using learned weights and a bias. Two inputs can produce one output. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain a linear layer learns weights
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: nn.Linear combines input features into output values using learned weights and a bias. Two inputs can produce one output.

blocks.code:
import torch

layer = torch.nn.Linear(2, 1)
x = torch.tensor([[1.0, 2.0]])
print(tuple(layer(x).shape))
blocks.title: A linear layer learns weights

blocks.text: The output shape is (1, 1). Its numeric value depends on initial random weights.
